name: New Museum of Contemporary Art
known: Founded in 1977 by curator Marcia Tucker, who led it until 1999.
Massimiliano Gioni was named director in July 2026 (Wikipedia).
Mellon Foundation: 1,500,000 dollars on 8 December 2022 for 36 months to support NEW INC's new director, Salome Asega (Mellon Foundation).

name: Printed Matter, Inc.
known: Ingrid Sischy was the first director in 1976.
AA Bronson was executive director from 2004 to 2010 and started the New York Art Book Fair in 2006 (Wikipedia).

Phil Aarons: W Magazine describes him as a real estate developer, co-founder of Millennium Partners and the board's president in 2014; he sits on the MoMA PS1 board, and the 2023 fair site thanks him and Shelley Fox Aarons by name.
Board chair Philip Aarons co-founded luxury developer Millennium Partners and was founding chair of Friends of the High Line.

name: Storefront for Art and Architecture
known: Directors: Kyong Park (executive director 1982 to 1998), Sarah Herda, Joseph Grima, Eva Franch i Gilabert (2010 to 2018) and José Esparza Chong Cuy (2018 to the present) (Wikipedia).

name: Triple Canopy
known: Staff include director Molly Kleiman and editor Alexander Provan (Triple Canopy website).
The website directs tax-deductible online contributions to a membership page, and lists a Director's Circle of individual donors.

name: White Columns
known: It describes its focus as artists who have not yet received wider critical, curatorial or commercial attention (White Columns).
Matthew Higgs is Director and Chief Curator.
Erin Somerville is Deputy Director and Curator (White Columns).
Exhibitions and projects supporting artists who have not yet received broad critical, curatorial or commercial attention.

name: e-flux
known: Companies on the New York register: E-FLUX, INC. (business corporation, filed 6 January 1999, Vidokle chairman), E-FLUX PROJECTS (not-for-profit, 2006), E-FLUX REALTY, LLC (2015) and ART DOMAIN, LLC, which runs Bar Laika (2015) (NY Department of State).
Owned and directed by founder Anton Vidokle through E-FLUX, INC.
